distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) reports China (NE) and Taiwan. The broad northeastern-China wording supports Mainland China = Present but is not expanded into provinces; Taiwan is accepted directly.

host_note: The source describes the species as polyphagous but explicitly states that no hosts were recorded in Taiwan. No host taxon is promoted from this source.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytoplatypus tycon Blandford, 1893.
